results.title: A caller-supplied `due_at` two years out
results.evidence: refused outright — the body model forbids unknown fields and carries no `due_at`, so the 30-day Critical window cannot be negotiated from any route

results.title: Raise the identical finding twice by hand
results.evidence: both accepted and both counted: nothing dedupes a human-raised finding, so one problem raised twice is two rows in the ageing profile

results.title: `set_status` to `closed`
results.evidence: refused: use close() — closure needs a verifier and evidence

results.title: `set_status` to an unknown value
results.evidence: no status vocabulary is checked: the finding now reads 'banana' and is still counted open, so the column can disagree with the acts

results.title: `set_status` back to `open` after an acknowledgement
results.evidence: the status moved in_remediation → open and the acknowledgement stands, because it is derived from the acts

results.title: Summary over a model with no findings
Estate-wide open findings under a scoped reader
results.evidence: the answer is short by 7 and says nothing about it: no count of what scope removed, and no `detail` saying the total is partial — so a reader reconciling against an estate-wide pack sees a discrepancy and reads it as a defect in the register
